steps.speaker: Ted's Man
steps.content: Boss!! Help!!!
Ted remains silent and pulls out a gun with a stern face as he walks toward you. Then with a swing of his hand, his gun smashes the back of the head of his lackey, who then passes out straight away.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: I'm ashamed of this, Chief. It won't happen again, I promise.
It's always good to quit while you're ahead. You stop Hella, who is enjoying herself, and turn to Ted.

steps.speaker: Choice
steps.content: I take our cooperation very seriously.
options: I take our cooperation very seriously.

steps.content: You're different from the gangsters. But these are just trivial problems compared to the powerful enemy we both face. You guys need any power you can get.

steps.speaker: Choice
steps.content: It's good to be honest before the final battle.|I got a bit carried away too.
options: It's good to be honest before the final battle.
I got a bit carried away too.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Haha, you're right, Chief. A fight like this is more direct than a verbal argument. I can see you already know to socialize with the Syndicans.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Now I know how important they are to you. I'm very surprised... but I'll get my men under control.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Haha, good. I've never been able to read you, but seeing you getting angry made me feel a bit closer to you.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: I didn't know how important they are to you. I'll get my men under control. Can't believe we dared to upset you. It's definitely our bad.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: I'm very grateful. I've come up with many plans to take down the SALVA basement, but every one of them is extremely risky.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: But it doesn't matter now that you're with us. Together, we'll be able to take down SALVA with minimal loss.
Now he knows his place. After seeing Ted off, you sit down against the wall and take a sip of water before you finally relax.
It wasn't necessary to go this far. In your position, you shouldn't have picked fights and shouldn't have taken unnecessary risks.
Yet, the trouble caused by those guys was too serious.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Forgive him this easily? He's just playing along in front of you. Who knows what he actually thinks?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I don't really believe him. It's just back-scratching.
That's fine. If he betrays, we'll be able to deal with him.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hmm... How impressive, Chief. You really have thought it through and managed to get Ted to do what you want.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: So was Ted right about—"they're important to you?"
You almost choke on the water.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Huh? Was it just a bluff? Was it genuine? Did you help me because we are important to you?
It's a misunderstanding, of course! For your own safety, you can't let the Sinners stay emotionally unstable for a long time. Who knows what she'll do when she gets furious?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Come on, Chief, tell me!
But the girl you've always been wary of is now blinking eagerly, waiting for your answer... This may be a chance to gain her trust.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Yes, I care about you girls.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You feel happy and sad, get scared and hurt. It's just that you have strange abilities and are a bit annoying.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: If this makes you a monster, then what about me who bind you with the "shackles"?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Pfft, stop finding similarities between us. I'm not as indecisive and awkward as you are.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I'm a free Sinner. One day, I'll break free from your shackles and regain my liberty again! You can keep your sentimentalism to yourself!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...Perhaps you see the shackles as a despicable bondage. But to me, it is our only real connection.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I guess yes. I care about you guys a lot.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Pfft, who are you trying to fool? You think I'll fall for this?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Listen. One day, I'll break free from your shackles. I want my liberty! Liberty! See ya!
She shakes off her hand and turns back after skipping a few steps away.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Nevertheless... as a coward who only ever hides behind people, you deserve recognition for standing up for me.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Before dumping you, I'll help you one more time. You should cherish this opportunity.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Don't you need to take down whatever that crazy hospital is?
She gives you a smile, unlike the ones she gave you in the past.
